page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head centred above it. Marginal notes stand in the left margin, beside the first paragraph and beside the paragraph "De scribendi". The black-letter passage and the italic heading sit within the column.

main_text.p: Saxonica affinis Fri-siaco orien-talis.Orientales autem Frisii ad Saxonum lin-guam proximè accedunt, nisi quòd prof. plerunquet proferunt: quamvis idem & Sa-xones quidam faciunt.
Belgica af-finis Galli-ca.Belgæ Germani, qui Gallis viciniores sunt, multa admixta Gallica vocabula usur-pant.
main_text.head: Oratio Dominica in lingua Islandica, quam puto eandem aut proximam esse Go-thorum linguæ in Scandinavia, de qua & paulò ante diximus.

p.bl: Bader vor / sun ert ci himmum : helgiz bitt namb tu:fomi ritt rike : verdi tinn vile/ suomsai himme / so ai podu:Burd vort dag-glgt gebtu oß i dag : og Bergeb oß skulden vorn / suo sem ui bergebun skulhun vorn: ant leid oß e ti Breifni. hellbur Brelsa tu oß Ber illu.tatz sic.

main_text.p: Germani-ca scriben-de & pro-feren-di ratio variaDe scribendi proferendiq; diversitate in aliis quibusdam Germaniæ regionibus: ut in Germanico quodam libro Fabiani Franci annotatum reperi.
Germani quidam efferunt & scribunt o pro a:e pro i:f pro y. Dicunt enim Franci sua

page.notes: The black-letter Oratio passage is read letter by letter and is uncertain throughout, especially "Bader", "ci", "helgiz", "Breifni" and the final words. The word "Breifni" is a guess from the shape. The left-margin note "Germanica ... ratio varia" is partly unclear in its hyphenation. The line "Germani quidam ..." has an underline under "Dicunt enim Franci sua", and a stain sits at the left edge of the page. No page number is printed.
